# Vizmatic Public Videos

> Open-source, code-first cinematic technical explainers built with Vizmatic (TypeScript + 3D math + synchronized narration + reproducible 1080p MP4 rendering). Every video asserts real mathematical or systems invariants at build time and deploys automatically to GitHub Pages.

- Live Gallery: https://bvolpato.github.io/vizmatic-public-videos/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/bvolpato/vizmatic-public-videos
- Vizmatic Engine: https://bvolpato.github.io/vizmatic/
- Agent Authoring Guide: https://github.com/bvolpato/vizmatic-public-videos/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## How AI Agents Should Create a Video Here

Follow this exact workflow when asked to create or improve a cinematic explainer in this repository:

1. **Scaffold & configure:**
   - Run `npm run new -- <slug> "<Title>"`.
   - Set `"featured": true` and `"published": "YYYY-MM-DD"` in `videos/<slug>/meta.json` to feature new releases on the homepage spotlight.
2. **Design for cinema, not PowerPoint:**
   - Full-bleed `1920 x 1080` dark canvas (`bleed: true`, `bloom: 0.22-0.24`, `#070910`), zero slide headers, zero `01 / 05` counters, zero boxy bullet cards, and zero unnecessary caveats/credits.
   - Open directly on Scene 1 (`hook`) from frame 0 (`intro: false`, `firstSceneTransition: 'cut'` in `film.ts`) with zero split-second intro title flash in the MP4. Put dedicated 1920x1080 thumbnail artwork in `scenes/poster.ts` (`export const poster: IntroFunction`); `factory/build.py` renders `poster.png` directly from `scenes/poster.ts` (and supports `--poster-only`). Target **2:30-3:30** total duration.
   - Teach **mechanisms** visually (crossing wires with traveling photons, sweeping laser cuts, 3D surface morphs) rather than static history charts.
   - Use plain-English analogies for hard concepts and visceral scale analogies for large numbers (for example, comparing `2^300` to atoms in the observable universe).
   - Keep all visible text `>= 26 px`, diversify poster layouts relative to neighboring videos, and rely on `factory/style.ts`'s 9-stop smooth `nebula()` plus `libx264` final encoding (default in `factory/build.py`) to avoid dark-gradient banding.
3. **Compute real models & assert invariants:**
   - Put exact numerical/algorithmic logic in `videos/<slug>/math.ts` and assert key invariants at build time in `videos/<slug>/film.ts` with `assertEqual`.
   - For 3D spheres (`parametricSurface`), span `v` over `[0, 1]` (`phi = v * Math.PI`) with `resolution: [56, 32]`+ to avoid polar holes and faceted edges, and compute exact latitude/great-circle radii (`samples: 200+`). For sequential 3D walls, use a 3/4 side-angle camera (`theta ~ -1.3`) and dynamic `line3d` segments for growing arcs.
4. **Finalize `script.json` and synthesize voice once:**
   - Write `beat.say` so ElevenLabs can read it directly (`"omega"`, `"Lean four"`, `"cat zero"`) while keeping `pronounce` entries for Kokoro.
   - Default free local Kokoro: `uv run factory/build.py <slug> --voice-only`
   - Optional ElevenLabs studio voice: `VIZMATIC_VOICE_PROVIDER=elevenlabs ELEVENLABS_VOICE=david ELEVENLABS_SPEED=1.08 uv run factory/build.py <slug> --voice-only`
   - Commit `timing.json`; GitHub Actions always renders with Kokoro so CI spends zero API credits.
5. **Verify at 30 fps and inspect rendered stills before full 1080p render:**
   - `uv run factory/build.py <slug> --check-only` (must pass with 0 errors, 0 warnings)
   - `(cd videos/<slug> && node ../../node_modules/vizmatic/dist/cli.js check film.ts --motion --text-size 26)` (target 0 findings across every frame; sequence crossfades with `delay(..., 0.2)` and guard hidden `dynamic` nodes with `< 0.02`)
   - Render preview stills (`node node_modules/vizmatic/dist/cli.js film videos/<slug>/film.ts --frame 0,20,60,120 --width 1280 --out videos/<slug>/stills/preview`) and standalone poster (`uv run factory/build.py <slug> --poster-only`), inspect every scene visually, then run `uv run factory/build.py <slug>` and `npm run site`.

## Key Repository Files

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/bvolpato/vizmatic-public-videos/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Complete authoring, 3D geometry, timing, and verification rules.
- [README.md](https://github.com/bvolpato/vizmatic-public-videos/blob/main/README.md): Full catalog, quickstart, caching, and ElevenLabs setup.
- [factory/style.ts](https://github.com/bvolpato/vizmatic-public-videos/blob/main/factory/style.ts): Shared `COSMOS` palette, `txt`, `nebula`, and deterministic `starfield` helpers.
- [factory/build.py](https://github.com/bvolpato/vizmatic-public-videos/blob/main/factory/build.py): Cached voice, audio mix, check, and 1080p render orchestrator.
- [factory/build-site.mjs](https://github.com/bvolpato/vizmatic-public-videos/blob/main/factory/build-site.mjs): Static GitHub Pages gallery generator (copies `llms.txt` to `site/llms.txt`).
- [factory/voice_elevenlabs.py](https://github.com/bvolpato/vizmatic-public-videos/blob/main/factory/voice_elevenlabs.py): Optional ElevenLabs `/with-timestamps` synthesizer.

## Latest Featured Films

- [P vs NP: The $1,000,000 Problem & the Live AI Proof Fleet](https://bvolpato.github.io/vizmatic-public-videos/p-vs-np/): Exponential search (`2^300` vs universe atoms), linear 3-SAT verification, what breaks if `P = NP` vs `P != NP`, three proof walls explained simply, and the live `pequalnp.com` Lean 4 AI proof fleet (`videos/p-vs-np/`).
- [Matrix Multiplication: Why ω = 9/4 Changes Computing](https://bvolpato.github.io/vizmatic-public-videos/matrix-exponent/): Visual evolution from Strassen crossing wires to Border Rank, Laser blocks, and polynomial degenerations, CAT(0) tripod geometry, the exact `α = 1/2` rectangular law, and real AI/GPU implications (`videos/matrix-exponent/`).
